purpose: Aggregate only trusted reconciled Revenue facts into one period baseline without raw/gross fallback or synthetic zero.
rules: ACTUAL output requires every included Revenue fact to normalize to ACTUAL with RECONCILED status, finite non-negative value, valid source/as_of/lineage, compatible explicit scope and target timezone.
DAILY mode requires expected_dates to explicitly equal the full requested date range; missing dates fail closed to GAP with value=null.
PERIODS mode derives coverage only from explicit fact periods; periods must be non-overlapping, contiguous and exactly cover the requested period.
Records outside the requested period fail closed; they are never silently ignored.
Mixed branch/channel scopes fail closed and are never collapsed to ALL.
ALL is accepted only when the target and every contributing fact explicitly carry aggregate_proven=true.
Duplicate facts are deterministically de-duplicated only when they carry the same privacy-safe stable fact identity and identical normalized financial truth; conflicts fail closed.
Missing, partial, untrusted, unreconciled, gross, invalid or negative Revenue never becomes monthly ACTUAL and never becomes zero.
Explicit proven zero remains ACTUAL zero when complete reconciled coverage is proven.
The derived output preserves privacy-safe lineage/evidence and never stores Drive locators or raw private records.
Missing reader returns NOT_CONNECTED; reader failure returns GAP; neither path falls back to raw or gross Revenue.
